meta.name: Single Papa
meta.description: When Gaurav finds a baby in the back of his car, he must defy his eccentric family, the adoption agency and societal norms to become a single papa.

videos.title: Dekho, mujhe kya mila?
videos.overview: While newly divorced Gaurav Gehlot is out enjoying single life, he finds a baby in the back of his car — and decides to do whatever it takes to keep him.

videos.title: Love nahi, lovest!
videos.overview: Shlok agrees to help Gaurav navigate the application process. But first, he has to win over the adoption agency — and his disapproving family.

videos.title: Dikha denge apni power!
videos.overview: Gaurav moves out of his parents' and baby-proofs his new home. When he learns Mrs. Nehra has other plans in mind for Amul, he begs for a second chance.

videos.title: Asli Single Papa
videos.overview: Jatin grows suspicious of Poonam. A change in Gaurav's circumstances prompts Mrs. Nehra to issue an ultimatum — meet her demands, or lose Amul forever.

videos.title: Chattan nahi, Parbat!
videos.overview: Sharanya finds a nanny for Amul who isn't what Gaurav was expecting. A flurry of surprise visitors creates an awkward situation for the new dad.

videos.title: "Papa bola"!
videos.overview: As her big day approaches, Namrata begs her family to reconcile — but as the truth about Amul threatens to be revealed, will the wedding even go ahead?
